body:
BrightAI, a startup that uses sensors, robots and AI to monitor physical infrastructure, has raised $97 million in a round led by Smith Point Capital, the growth firm started by former Salesforce co-CEO Keith Block, Fortune reported on Wednesday [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). GE Vernova, an existing customer, joined the round along with Cobalt Capital, Marlinspike Partners and Zero Infinity Partners, and existing backers Khosla Ventures, Inspired Capital and Upfront Ventures [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

The company has raised $184 million in total, and the round valued it at $750 million, according to a person familiar with the matter cited by Fortune [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). BrightAI did not disclose revenue; founder and CEO Alex Hawkinson told Fortune he "doesn't care" about reaching unicorn status [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

BrightAI's Stateful platform combines edge sensors on poles, pipelines, compressors and tanks with autonomous robots, drones and wearable AI assistants for field crews, so that equipment is watched continuously instead of checked on a fixed schedule [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). The company said the system runs at more than 50,000 locations and that customers on average see trouble about 51 days before a likely catastrophic failure [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

Customers include GE Vernova, waste-to-energy company Reworld, Osmose Utilities Services, Azuria Water Solutions, Kodiak Gas Services and Diamondback Energy [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). "The Romans are laughing at us," Hawkinson told Fortune, referring to inspection methods that have changed little since antiquity [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

Hawkinson founded BrightAI in 2019 and bootstrapped it for four years [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). He earlier co-founded SmartThings, the connected-home hub he sold to Samsung in 2014 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). BrightAI doubled its headcount in 2025 but did not give a total [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

p: 센서·로봇·AI로 물리적 인프라를 모니터링하는 스타트업 BrightAI가 Smith Point Capital이 주도한 라운드에서 9700만 달러를 조달했다고 Fortune이 수요일 보도했다. Smith Point Capital은 Salesforce 전 공동 CEO Keith Block이 설립한 그로스 투자사다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). 기존 고객사인 GE Vernova가 이번 라운드에 참여했으며, Cobalt Capital, Marlinspike Partners, Zero Infinity Partners와 기존 투자자인 Khosla Ventures, Inspired Capital, Upfront Ventures도 함께했다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

Fortune이 인용한 소식통에 따르면 BrightAI의 누적 조달액은 총 1억8400만 달러이며, 이번 라운드에서 기업가치는 7억5000만 달러로 평가됐다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). BrightAI는 매출을 공개하지 않았다. 창업자 겸 CEO Alex Hawkinson은 Fortune에 유니콘 반열에 오르는 것에는 "관심이 없다"고 말했다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

BrightAI의 Stateful 플랫폼은 전봇대, 파이프라인, 압축기, 탱크에 설치하는 엣지 센서에 자율 로봇, 드론, 현장 작업자용 웨어러블 AI 어시스턴트를 결합해, 설비를 정해진 일정에 따라 점검하는 대신 상시 감시하도록 한다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). 회사에 따르면 이 시스템은 5만 곳 이상에서 가동 중이며, 고객사는 평균적으로 치명적 고장이 발생할 가능성이 큰 시점보다 약 51일 앞서 이상 징후를 포착한다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

고객사로는 GE Vernova, 폐기물 에너지화 기업 Reworld, Osmose Utilities Services, Azuria Water Solutions, Kodiak Gas Services, Diamondback Energy 등이 있다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). Hawkinson은 고대 이후 거의 달라지지 않은 점검 방식을 언급하며 Fortune에 "로마인들이 우리를 비웃고 있다"고 말했다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).

Hawkinson은 2019년 BrightAI를 설립해 4년간 외부 투자 없이 자체 자금으로 회사를 운영했다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). 그는 앞서 스마트홈 허브 SmartThings를 공동 창업해 2014년 Samsung에 매각했다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/). BrightAI는 2025년 인력 규모를 두 배로 늘렸으나 총인원은 밝히지 않았다 [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/11/18/brightai-alex-hawkinson-physical-ai-unicorn-roman-infrastructure-inspections/).
